old: Every counterclockwise cycle contributes the same amount to the sign, so the sign of a group depends on `n` and `c` only.
new: A counterclockwise cycle of length `h` contributes `(-1)^((h+3)/2)`. Multiplying over a cover gives `(-1)^((n-c)/2)`, so the group sign depends on `n` and `c`, although individual cycle signs depend on length.
